_notes: Single source of truth for deployed function config. deploy-create.js reads this at create time; deploy-update.js applies it on update; the fleet audit checks it.

Timeout rule: never shorten a timeout at deploy time — the value here is max(declared in functions/index.js, currently deployed). Three functions run LONGER than declared (startOutfitParse, retryOutfitGarment, pollOutfitParse: deployed 300s vs declared 120s) and keep 300s because the parse poll is load-bearing. Shortening them is a planning decision, not a deploy fix.

Memory is the declared value where it differs from the 512Mi default. approveStandardization / rejectStandardization declare 256Mi but run at 512Mi — the deployed direction is harmless, so they are not listed and take the default.

PC-106 (2026-11-26): the fleet has NO event-triggered function anymore — autoStandardizeItem was deleted (it never fired once; the Firestore trigger was replaced by a direct client call + sweeper). The eventTrigger audit stays: any future event-triggered function must declare its trigger here, because a REST create sends no trigger unless the create body carries one.
